introDialogue: ^My son, you must ride ahead, and inform the Imperial forces of our defection.
^The Emperor will need our forces if he seeks to defeat the Shogun.
^But father, I cannot wield a blade nor fire a rifle, how will I ensure my safety?

^Take this letter, it will inform our would-be allies that both we and the Tsu clan will ride to join forces with the Imperial army, and of current Shogunate positions. Surely they know better than to...
